module: Node "Vehicle Selector" (color ui, singleActive, depends on core_input_bindings). Opens a start screen (via the ui module) with a vehicle selector for an opponent: text panel, vehicleSelector panel (name, thumbnail, Power/Weight/Top Speed stats), "Change Opponent" and "Abandon" buttons. Inputs: flow, reset (pulse), title, text, startButtonText (hidden), changeOpponentLabel, abandonLabel, saveSelection (keeps the last choice between restarts; otherwise returns to the player's vehicle). Outputs: flow (once Start is pressed), exit (Abandon pressed), model, config, color, dial (hidden, 1/4-mile time, 12 by default).
notes: Local functions: getVehicleDial (core_vehicles config "Performance Data"/"Drag Times" .time_1_4, otherwise 12), getVehicleColor (default paint of the model/config), getVehicleDisplayData.
The stats are obtained via ui_vehicleSelector_vehicleSpecifications.makeSpec, loaded on demand.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

getSavedVehData.desc: Returns the selection stored on the flowgraph manager (mgr._vehicleSelectorSavedVeh), shared by all Vehicle Selector nodes of the project.

setSavedVehData.desc: Stores the selection on the flowgraph manager.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the output pins to false and resets the state.

_executionStopped.desc: Closes the dialogue and resets the state.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook on the client side; closes the dialogue.

reset.desc: Resets built/done/exited and resets the output pins to false (called via the reset pin).

closeDialogue.desc: If the screen is built, navigates to "play" and clears modules.ui.uiLayout.

getSelectedVehicleDisplayData.desc: Returns the display data (name, thumbnail, stats) of the selected vehicle, or nil.

getDefaultVehicle.desc: Returns {model, config} of the player's current vehicle (core_vehicles.getCurrentVehicleDetails) or nil.

buildScreen.desc: Builds the start screen via the ui module (header, Start button, panels, Change Opponent / Abandon buttons) then finishUIBuilding. Logs an error if the ui module is missing.

requestChangeOpponent.desc: Opens the game's vehicle selector (ui_vehicleSelector_general.openVehicleSelectorForChallenge, loaded if needed). On return, stores the choice and requests a rebuild of the screen.

startFromUi.desc: Marks the choice as confirmed (done=true) and closes the dialogue.

abandonFromUi.desc: Sets exited=true and closes the dialogue.

work.desc: Handles reset; on the first frame chooses the vehicle (saved if saveSelection, otherwise default) and builds the screen; rebuilds if requested; publishes model, config, color, dial, flow (done) and exit.
